creature: Observed female Joppa farmers and convert; shared race fitting

resident.description: Her kufiya has been cut and resewn to a cowl, and she has tailored a vinewafer sack to approximate the slate habit of the chromaic people. A sheaf of watervine bundled in copper wire is slung on her hip, and she rubs a salt-nailed thumb over a talisman of cracked circuitboard.

The tatters of a sweat-stained kufiya thrash in the wind from where they hang about the farmer's neck. Clasped in her gnarled, brown hand is a curved vinereaper of iron with which she culls moisture-swollen wafers from the viridian plant called watervine.
